verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Authenticator supports OTP codes and QR-based setup generally, but there is no first-party documentation explicitly walking through 'scan QR → get TOTP codes' for a new arbitrary account, and hands-on community reports describe a known, unresolved bug where scanning a QR code fails/misbehaves, forcing users to cancel the dialog and manually add the account instead of getting immediate code generation. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of the QR-scan-to-TOTP flow, and confirmation the reported QR scanning bug has been fixed.
